Billiard halls in Greece

Looking for somewhere to play billiards? Here are 66 halls in 26 cities, each with its address. We researched the directory by hand for RackUp, the app that puts you in touch with other players for a game on a real table.

Find an opponent on RackUp

Post the hall, the game (8-Ball, 9-Ball or 10-Ball) and the time, and see who takes the table. Or ask to join a table someone else has posted. Every player carries a category from Pro down to E, so you know what you are walking into.
